zh: 主菜我要羊肉。
en: I'll have the lamb for my {main course|main}.

zh: 给我们来点自来水就行，谢谢。
en: Just some {tap water} for the table, please.

zh: 配菜您想要薯条还是沙拉？
en: Would you like chips or salad as a {side dish|side}?

zh: 请给我一杯大杯的馥芮白（平白咖啡）。
en: A large {flat white}, please.

zh: 我们能看一下酒单吗？
en: Could we see the {wine list}, please?

zh: 请问还有两人桌吗？
en: Do you have a {table for two}?

zh: 你们有无麸质的选择吗？
en: Do you have any {gluten-free options|gluten free options}?

zh: 请问在座的各位有食物过敏吗？
en: Does anyone at the table have any {food allergies}?

zh: 这家酒吧五点到七点有欢乐时光（酒水特价时段）。
en: This bar has a {happy hour} from five to seven.

zh: 能给我们分开的账单吗？
en: Can we have {separate bills|separate checks}, please?

zh: 如果自带酒水，要收开瓶费。
en: There's a {corkage fee|corkage charge} if you bring your own wine.

zh: 我们就来一瓶店里自选的佐餐酒吧。
en: We'll just have a bottle of the {house wine}.

zh: 我们不喝酒，来点软饮料就行。
en: We don't drink alcohol, so just {soft drinks} for us.

zh: 你们的每日特色菜是什么？
en: What's your {daily special}?

zh: 你们有户外座位吗？
en: Do you have any {outdoor seating|outside seating}?

zh: 周五晚上我们常买炸鱼薯条吃。
en: We often get {fish and chips} on Friday nights.

zh: 厨房九点半接受最后点单。
en: The kitchen takes {last orders} at nine thirty.

zh: 这里没有桌边服务，要到柜台点餐。
en: There's no {table service} here, so you order at the counter.

zh: 您要无气的水还是气泡水？
en: Would you like still or {sparkling water|fizzy water}?

zh: 你们有儿童菜单吗？
en: Do you have a {kids' menu|kids menu|children's menu}?

zh: 账单里已经包含了服务费。
en: The bill already includes a {service charge}.

zh: 我订了周六晚上七点的晚餐位。
en: I've made a {dinner booking|dinner reservation} for seven on Saturday.

zh: 我们吃不完，能给我们一个打包袋吗？
en: We can't finish this. Could we get a {doggy bag|takeaway box|takeaway container}?

zh: 这家店每份菜的分量都特别大。
en: The {portion sizes|portions|serving sizes|servings} here are huge.

zh: 这家餐厅只用本地农产品。
en: This restaurant only uses {local produce}.

zh: 我早上通常喝一杯长黑咖啡。
en: I usually have a {long black} in the morning.

zh: 我们点了七道菜的品鉴菜单。
en: We ordered the seven-course {tasting menu|degustation menu}.

zh: 甜点我要香草冰淇淋。
en: I'll have vanilla {ice cream|ice-cream} for dessert.

zh: 早午餐我点了牛油果吐司配水波蛋。
en: I ordered avocado on toast with {poached eggs} for brunch.

zh: 吃完主菜后，服务员拿来了甜品单。
en: The waiter brought the {dessert menu} after our mains.
